view.en: Top-down 2D dungeon room with crates, pillars or trees as cover. You control an armoured gunner, and the mouse moves a crosshair; your health (red), armour (grey) and energy (blue) are at the top left, the boss's name, health bar and phase at the top centre, and your current weapon at the bottom right

goal.en: Empty the boss's health bar to win; you lose if your health reaches zero; each fight lasts at most 300 seconds and a timeout is not a win. Health does not regenerate

mouse.en: Weapons attack toward the crosshair; if you leave the mouse still for about 2 seconds while the boss is in sight, the crosshair pulls toward the boss automatically

keys.en: hold to attack: guns keep firing, the broad blade swings; with a gun at point-blank range you stab with a knife automatically
skill "duplicate weapon": wield a second copy of the current weapon for 5 seconds, then a 10-second cooldown
switch to the next weapon: basic pistol → repeater gun → bullet-clearing broad blade

notes.en: WASD combine into eight directions; you move slower while holding attack
Armour absorbs damage before health; after about 3 seconds without being hit, armour regenerates 1 point per second
The repeater gun and the broad blade use energy per attack; the basic pistol is free, so switch back to it when energy runs out
The broad blade's swing destroys ordinary bullets inside its arc
At half health the boss enters its second phase (enraged): it attacks faster, its bullets fly faster, and it gains new attacks
There is no roll or jump; dodge by moving and using cover

options.none: keep the crosshair still (after 2 s it auto-aims at a visible boss)

options.fire_skill: hold attack and use the duplicate-weapon skill
options.switch: switch to the next weapon (then keep attacking)

summary.en: A caster walks around an open room, calling meteors, orbiting orbs, turrets and star bullets.

tell.en: Several impact markers appear on the ground (more when enraged)

effect.en: Meteors hit the marked spots

counter.en: Leave the marked spots as soon as they appear

tell.en: Two orbs circle the boss and can stack up

effect.en: Touching an orb hurts

counter.en: Keep your distance from the boss

tell.en: It fires a shot that leaves a line of turrets behind it

effect.en: The turrets fire sideways, perpendicular to the line

counter.en: Do not stand beside the turret line; the broad blade can destroy turrets

tell.en: It releases a ring of six stars

effect.en: Each star splits into three smaller bullets

counter.en: Slip through the gaps between the stars

phases.en: When enraged it calls four meteors instead of three and attacks faster

summary.en: A walking tree that hides among two rings of crates; it holds up an energy ball that sprays bullets, sends shockwaves, and rams you once enraged.

tell.en: It raises a big energy ball overhead

effect.en: The ball sprays bullets in every direction

counter.en: Hide behind crates

tell.en: It throws the held ball at you

effect.en: It sprays bullets in flight and explodes on impact

counter.en: Sidestep its flight path

tell.en: Lines appear on the ground and shockwaves travel along them

effect.en: The shockwaves hurt

counter.en: Step off the drawn lines

tell.en: A charge band toward you appears on the ground; when it brightens the direction is locked

effect.en: It dashes straight along the band, smashing through crates, and takes no damage while charging

counter.en: Leave the band as soon as it brightens

tell.en: It releases five homing shots that start chasing you after a short pause

effect.en: They hurt on hit

counter.en: Circle around cover so they hit obstacles

tell.en: It fires big cross-shaped bullets all around

effect.en: They hurt on hit

counter.en: Stand in the gaps between them

tell.en: It sends a line of shockwaves toward you

effect.en: The shockwaves hurt

counter.en: Move sideways off the line

phases.en: Entering the enraged phase it sends shockwaves in seven directions, then adds the ram, homing shots, cross bullets and the shockwave line

summary.en: A poison flower that almost always sits in its own poison pool, pressing you with slow bubbles, rotating bullet streams and poison shots; it sprouts tentacles when enraged.

tell.en: It blows a ring of slow bubbles that fade after a few seconds

effect.en: Bubbles hurt on contact

counter.en: Weave slowly between them

tell.en: Bullet streams fire from four points in four directions and rotate; they are slower than you

effect.en: The streams hurt on hit

counter.en: Circle in the same direction as the rotation

tell.en: It fires green beam-like bullets all around

effect.en: They hurt and poison you

counter.en: Get behind cover or back off

tell.en: It spreads a poison pool beneath itself

effect.en: Standing in it poisons and slows you

counter.en: Do not fight up close; attack from outside the pool

tell.en: Four fast bullets fly toward the room's corners, leaving spreading bubble trails

effect.en: Both the bullets and the bubbles hurt

counter.en: Stay off the lines toward the corners

tell.en: It releases a wave that pulls you toward it

effect.en: It deals no damage but drags you toward danger; walls partly block it

counter.en: Move away from it and hug a wall

phases.en: When enraged the flower opens and four tentacles appear; it then adds corner shots and the pulling wave, and mixes poison shots into the rotating streams

summary.en: A big jelly boss in a room with slowing and speeding floor tiles: it slams the ground for bullets, summons small jellies, and once enraged swells up and explodes after taking enough hits.

tell.en: It slams the ground twice

effect.en: Clusters of red bullets fly out in random directions at random speeds

counter.en: Back off and find gaps between the bullets

tell.en: It fires four rings of bullets in quick succession

effect.en: The bullets stop mid-air after a distance and slowly form a flower shape

counter.en: Pass through the gaps between the petals

tell.en: It spawns a small jelly beside itself

effect.en: Small jellies hurt on contact

counter.en: Clear them as you go

tell.en: It slams the ground, leaving a green poison pool and lingering bullets

effect.en: The pool poisons you and the bullets hurt

counter.en: Stay out of the pool

phases.en: Once enraged it explodes right away (the expanding circle is the blast radius), and again after about 15 more hits; the slow and boost tiles affect the boss too

summary.en: A cloaked boss in a room with no cover at all, casting purple poison pools, tentacles and a sweeping laser; it is invulnerable while standing in a pool.

tell.en: It lays four purple pools in a line toward you

effect.en: The pools poison and slow you; the boss is invulnerable while it stands in one

counter.en: Avoid the pools; while it is in one, dodge and wait until it steps out

tell.en: Four tentacles sprout at random spots in the room

effect.en: The tentacles attack you when you are near

counter.en: Keep away from them, or destroy them first

tell.en: It fires small bullets in every direction

effect.en: They hurt on hit

counter.en: Find the gaps between them

tell.en: It rings a sharp chime, and the starting line and the swept sector are drawn on the floor

effect.en: The laser sweeps through the sector for heavy damage; it does nothing else while firing

counter.en: Leave the drawn sector at the chime, then counterattack after the sweep

tell.en: It fires a large bullet that keeps spinning out spirals of small bullets

effect.en: Both hurt; the spirals stop only when the large bullet is destroyed

counter.en: Destroy the large bullet first

phases.en: When enraged it attacks more often, and the laser charges faster and sweeps faster

summary.en: A big worm in a room with stacked crates in the corners fires explosive shells and spreads, burrows underground, and surfaces near you.

tell.en: It leans back and fires a large explosive shell; its blast radius is drawn around it in flight

effect.en: It explodes on hitting a wall, a crate or you, over a wide area

counter.en: Sidestep it and leave the drawn blast circle

tell.en: It fires a wide fan of big bullets that slow down as they travel

effect.en: They burst in a small blast on impact

counter.en: Back off and slip between them

tell.en: It sinks underground and only a moving dirt mound is visible (the HUD shows that it cannot be attacked)

effect.en: Burrowing and surfacing cause shockwaves, and it leaves stars that fire bullets around

counter.en: Stay away from the mound and attack after it surfaces

phases.en: When enraged it burrows faster and makes several quick dives, briefly surfacing between them, and leaves more bullets each time it comes up
